specs.title: invalid/oversized/versioned/forged imports leave current memory and browser save unchanged
corrupt browser save is retained and can be backed up before explicit replacement; cancellation changes nothing
disabled storage remains usable in memory and gives a backup warning instead of success
quota failure retains core interactions and the old browser value
a second tab cannot be silently overwritten and reloading its version requires confirmation
